rationale: Raw reads recovered exactly from the deposited MAGeCK-normalized table (one scale factor per column, integrality 100%). The paper compares PFOS (192 uM, 10 doublings) with untreated control, 3 vs 3; column names map one-to-one to the GSM titles (Control_1-3, PFOS_1-3). Replicate numbers are not described as paired infections and the correlations do not show pairing, so no replicate term. Non-targeting and safe-harbor guides are the controls. The plasmid/T0 column named in the sheet title was not deposited.
